title: List cell: a markdown value starting with a heading draws at heading size in the cell (truncated, and the row grows from 36 to 45 px)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oY5WCqqqBMtn9qt7m

## What happens

In a list with a `markdown` column shown, a value such as `# Heading` draws at H1 size inside the list cell, truncated to `Headin…`, and that row is 45 px tall against 36 px for a row with no rich values. It happens with no editor open.

Reading: Chromium at 1280 px, the showcase field zoo list, on PR #36278's head `bc9b5c23` (that PR does not touch the display path: `MarkdownCellRenderer`, `prose-sm`). Found while dispatching #36023; not measured on main separately, but the display code is the same as main's.

## Done when

- A list cell draws markdown headings at the cell's own text size (a one-line preview), so a rich value does not change the row height.
- A pin on the cell renderer with a heading value, with an ablation.
- The record page and other full-size markdown displays keep their heading sizes.

Out of scope: in-cell editing of rich-text fields (#36023).
